fusions.name: Out of Still Water
fusions.desc: Fires an arrow that deals 14 damage to the first enemy it meets and stuns it for 1.2 seconds. It has 40% more critical chance against a target that has not been hurt yet.

fusions.name: Drag Under
fusions.desc: Looses a barbed arrow at a target up to 7 tiles away that deals 28 water damage, leaves it [Pinned] for 3 seconds and makes it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds. Against a boss or elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Below the Waterline
fusions.desc: Veils you for 6 seconds: enemies notice you 60% later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Long Wait
fusions.desc: After 10 seconds without a critical hit, your crit chance rises by 40% for your next strike. Once every 10 seconds.
